items.text: Design, develop, and maintain scalable front-end applications using React and modern web technologies.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Build reusable, maintainable, and high-performance UI components following best practices and component-based architecture.
Collaborate with designers, backend engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality user experiences.
Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and front-end engineering standards.
Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues, and provide timely incident resolution in accordance with SLA requirements.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, estimation, and continuous improvement of development processes.
Research, evaluate, and adopt modern front-end technologies, tools, and best practices to improve engineering productivity.
Mentor team members and contribute to technical knowledge sharing and engineering excellence.

description.text:
我們是台灣肯德基與必勝客的數位轉型團隊，致力於打造高效、直覺且穩定的數位產品體驗。
隨著產品與技術日漸成長，我們正在尋找對技術充滿熱情、重視團隊合作的你，一起推動產品往更現代化、更使用者友善的方向發展!
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable front-end applications using React and modern web technologies.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Build reusable, maintainable, and high-performance UI components following best practices and component-based architecture.
* Collaborate with designers, backend engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality user experiences.
* Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
* Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and front-end engineering standards.
* Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues, and provide timely incident resolution in accordance with SLA requirements.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, estimation, and continuous improvement of development processes.
* Research, evaluate, and adopt modern front-end technologies, tools, and best practices to improve engineering productivity.
* Mentor team members and contribute to technical knowledge sharing and engineering excellence.
【我們正在找這樣的你】
你喜歡打造流暢的使用者體驗，也在意程式碼的結構與品質；你不只寫程式，也願意與夥伴一同設計出更好的產品。
我們希望你是那個樂於分享、擁抱新知、願意一起打拼的夥伴。 加入我們，讓技術驅動肯德基與必勝客的下一個進化！

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of front-end development experience with strong proficiency in React and TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with Next.js, including SSR, SSG, routing, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Sass, and responsive web design.
* Experience building reusable, maintainable, and scalable component-based applications.
* Familiarity with state management solutions such as Redux or Context API.
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs or GraphQL with backend services.
* Knowledge of front-end build tools, testing frameworks, and CI/CD workflows.
* Strong understanding of web performance optimization, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP or Azure).
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
* Experience with Git, Agile/Scrum, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience mentoring junior developers and participating in code reviews.
